kpis.name_fr: CA Wizards of the Coast & Digital Gaming
kpis.name_en: Wizards of the Coast & Digital Gaming Revenue
kpis.signal: Joyau Hasbro, record 2025 +44.7% porte par MAGIC: THE GATHERING (Universes Beyond: Final Fantasy, Spider-Man, Avatar) et MONOPOLY GO!
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Wizards of the Coast & Digital Gaming : MAGIC: THE GATHERING, DUNGEONS & DRAGONS, jeux digitaux et licensing (MONOPOLY GO!). Plus haute marge du groupe.
kpis.description_en: Wizards of the Coast & Digital Gaming segment revenue: MAGIC: THE GATHERING, DUNGEONS & DRAGONS, digital games and licensing (MONOPOLY GO!). Highest margin segment.

kpis.signal: MAGIC: THE GATHERING record 2025, Final Fantasy = set le plus vendu de tous les temps, +638M$ vs 2024 sur la franchise
kpis.description_fr: CA tabletop : MAGIC: THE GATHERING (dominant) + D&D + autres. Set Final Fantasy = best-seller historique, Universes Beyond strategie majeure.
kpis.description_en: Tabletop revenue: MAGIC: THE GATHERING (dominant) + D&D + others. Final Fantasy set = all-time best-seller, Universes Beyond key strategy.

kpis.signal: Marge op segment 46.0% en 2025 (vs 41.8% en 2024), expansion massive driven by revenue mix et MAGIC pricing
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Wizards/Digital. Marge op = 46.0% en 2025. Le segment porte la profitabilite du groupe (Consumer Products en perte).
kpis.description_en: Wizards/Digital segment operating profit. Op margin = 46.0% in 2025. Segment drives group profitability (Consumer Products in loss).

kpis.signal: Segment toys/CP en repli 2025 (-4.2%), volume impacte par tendances industrie et tariffs en Amerique du Nord, marges sous pression
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer Products : NERF, MONOPOLY, TRANSFORMERS, MY LITTLE PONY, PLAY-DOH. Sourcing, marketing et vente de jouets et jeux physiques.
kpis.description_en: Consumer Products segment revenue: NERF, MONOPOLY, TRANSFORMERS, MY LITTLE PONY, PLAY-DOH. Sourcing, marketing and sales of physical toys and games.

kpis.signal: Hit mobile Scopely en croissance forte (+50% en 2025), pure marge licensing, asset-light revenue stream
kpis.description_fr: CA licensing MONOPOLY GO! du partenaire Scopely (mobile game). Pure marge licensing, contribution croissante a Digital & Licensed Gaming.
kpis.description_en: MONOPOLY GO! licensing revenue from Scopely partner (mobile game). Pure licensing margin, growing contribution to Digital & Licensed Gaming.
